'''Idris Ro''' was a member of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Ro contracted the freelance [[Scout/Legends|scout]] and Alliance sympathizer [[Jobany Cyrs]] to produce a report on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Socorro/Legends|Socorro]] with the intent of evaluating its suitability as an Alliance base.<ref name="BSS" />
